title: Sync in an older binary fails cleanly on a newer origin
body: Check that absorb_origin bails at the gate rather than merging meta.json; add a test with two clones on different schemas if it does not.
close_reason: gate on origin before fast-forward or merge; test with two clones where origin is at schema 99

notes.author: Jack Roddy/6de6737a
notes.text: Finding: it did not fail cleanly. A fast-forward in absorb_origin never decodes, so an older foam moved its local ref onto the newer commit and only the next command hit the gate. Fixed with a gate on origin's meta.json before any fast-forward or merge; sync now says origin's data is schema N and leaves the local ref. After that every command in the clone stops at the same gate until a newer foam is installed, which is the designed behaviour.
